text_block_list.text:
One day, as I was walking through campus, 
I saw…

text_block_list.name: Rat?
text_block_list.text: Squeak, squeak! Bakushin, Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Cat?
text_block_list.text: Meow, meow! Bakushin, Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Negative!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's the class president!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: And, oh no――! They're coming!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, it's an impersonation!! To avoid being 
noticed by the subjects of research――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Aah!? The subjects have disappeared!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: We must search for them!! Trainer!

I wasn't quite sure what was going on, but 
I was worried about her being on her own, 
so I decided to follow her…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The ground, it doesn't seem to be looking 
too good today…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This is due to the rain the day before. It 
is my hypothesis that this is ideal for 
training in anticipation of poor track 
conditions.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But, with Rice's misfortune, something 
might happen…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Though, I seem to recall that dealing with 
irregular situations is part of your 
training?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ms. Bourbon… You're right, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. More importantly, I'm rather 
curious about something.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh, the mud is so heavy… Quite the 
formidable foe this track condition is to 
get even someone like myself stuck!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However, it's hard to hear what you're 
saying. Especially Ms. Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hypothe… saurus?……Irregu… lar? A part… a 
part of your tuna-ing?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps, after training you are going to a 
sushi restaurant!? Uuuuu, I must go there 
too, so I can do my research while I'm at 
it!!
choice_data_list: Those are your two research subjects?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oya!? How did you know that!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I'm currently studying those two 
as potential future rivals…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's a big project, so it was necessary to 
be careful, and I had to keep it a secret 
from even you, Trainer. Now, then…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Surely, you must be a telepath, Trainer! 
You're a telepathic trainer, aren't you? 
It's a kind of Uma, isn't it!?
choice_data_list: It's not an Uma, or a UMA.
It's not an Uma, or a UMA.

text_block_list.text:
I know what Sakura Bakushin O is doing, 
sneaking around and spying on the two of 
them, but…
choice_data_list: Why are those two your rivals?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Very well, I'll tell you, as class 
president. Those two are next year's most 
popular Classic class Umas!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In other words, they're naturally destined 
to showdown with me as I continue down the 
Bakushin Road!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Rice Shower. She is a small stayer, 
but a very good one. She also looks timid, 
but she has a competitive spirit.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Mihono Bourbon. She has the speed to 
be a sprinter and the stamina to keep it 
up.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Both of them are formidable opponents, but 
in my expert opinion, I believe Ms. 
Bourbon to be the best rival.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
After all, her speed is quite the threat. 
She'll definitely be competing with me in 
the early stages of the race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
…Say, wait a minute, are you listening to 
me!? You're just staring at me with your 
mouth wide open!
choice_data_list: I just thought it was a great analysis.

text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O, who always seems to 
have a tendency to act rashly, is giving a 
very thoughtful and respectable analysis…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! After all, I am the class 
president!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The analysis of one's rivals should be 
done before breakfast―no, before dinner!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
With this kind of research, I'll have no 
problem winning any race, even in middle 
or long distances!

…Better just to keep quiet about the fact 
that most important premise is blatantly 
incorrect. Ah, right over there…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Ms. Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hawaa!?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
From the time I arrived at school until 
now, I noticed that I was being tracked by 
Ms. Bakushin-O.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Rice and I came to the conclusion that 
you had some business with us. We'll 
listen.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Aaaaahhh―uh!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I am absolutely not!! Researching you 
two!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? R, researching…?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This is why! You should go ahead and 
please take your sweet time while you 
practice!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Squeaaak!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh, Ms. Bakushin O! If you run too fast…!
(Slip!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Gyaawaaahhh――!?!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Awawaa…! Ms. Bakushin O is all covered in 
mud because Rice called out to her…!

As I helped the fallen Sakura Bakushin O 
up, I thought again about how to deal with 
her passion for the Bakushin Road…
